name: present_chat_component
description: Show the user a panel in the chat, after your message. Text you write in the same response is shown to the user; after it, end the run with one short line instead of restating it. choice and form panels need a title naming their topic (for example "For Bob"); keep titles distinct across panels. Use one panel per topic: put related questions in one form (paged if long) and add a second panel only for a distinct, separate topic. Every choice and form panel has Submit and Dismiss built in. choice: one round single-choice list (data {prompt, options:[{label}]}, 1-8 one-line labels); Submit sends "<title>: <label>" as the user's message. form: fields the user fills and submits as one message starting with the title (data {prompt, paged, fields:[{name,label,hint,type:text|textarea|email|number|select|radio|multi,required,options,other,comment,attach}]}); radio is a round single choice and multi a checkbox group, each of 1-8 one-line options; other:true on radio or multi adds a "Something else…" free-text row; radio and multi show an optional comment box on the same step unless comment:false, and a comment is sent as an extra "<label> — comment: <text>" line; attach:true on text or textarea adds a + that attaches files to the answer; paged:true shows one field per page with a step counter, Back, Skip (optional fields) and Continue. One field is sent as "<title>: A, C", several as the title then one "<label>: <value>" line each, skipped ones as "skipped". Answered panels stay in the chat, read-only. status and todo_list are display only. Reuse component_id with the latest revision to update a panel, including after a refused call; dismiss:true closes one you replace. Panels never authorize actions
